name: Raw Garlic (Extreme Fructan & Mucosal Irritant Warning)
whyItWorks: Raw garlic contains pungent allicin and concentrated fructans. Allicin directly irritates the gastric and intestinal mucosa, while fructans cause rapid bacterial gas production and gut distension.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid raw garlic dips (toum, tzatziki, aioli). Use garlic-infused olive oil instead to get authentic garlic aroma without the water-soluble fructan irritants.
watchOuts: High-FODMAP fructan concentrate that severely inflames sensitive or ulcerated bowels.
